description: Sri Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates Exchange effective from 30.07.2018 to 05.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organisational, land, commercial, or other specialized category.
